frame: table: origin white plate center; +X toward gray plate; +Y toward bowl; +Z up; right-handed

pixel_pick_uncertainty.scenarios: Two fixed sensitivities: white quad expanded/contracted 3px on each axis about its center. Other pixel anchors remain fixed; not a statistical or worst-case uncertainty bound.

limitations: Plate stud counts are visual hypotheses; white size sets scale and gray48 is only an independent nominal comparison.
Black tape conceals exact plate edges. Ruler0/20 marks are manually estimated and independent of the homography fit.
One plane approximates tabletop and raised plates; no lens distortion or phone intrinsics are inferred.
Base foot is occluded; its approximate image center is not a calibrated FR3 frame or yaw. Bowl rim is above the table and not its measured contact footprint.
Homography reprojection error cannot establish physical accuracy. Two perturbations omit independent point-pick, height/parallax, lens and dimension errors.
Marker board visually7x5 squares; dictionary, printed dimensions and scaling unknown. It does not establish an extrinsic calibration.
